request.description: Seamless perpetual loop of this original engraved armillary sphere. Animate EACH orbital hoop independently, not as one rigid cage. The large meridian hoop spins in its upright polar plane; the broad equatorial band spins horizontally; the upper and lower latitude hoops counter-rotate separately; the little polar hoops have their own gentle spins. Each hoop follows its OWN circular plane and axis, with distinct phase and alternating direction. Engraved hatch marks travel with each band so its rotation is visible. Smooth constant angular speeds, complete revolutions, matching starting and ending orientations AND velocities. No acceleration, deceleration, pauses, rocking, reversal or jerk at the seam. The central plain ivory sphere, its grid and shading stay FROZEN. NO sphere rotation, continents or new markings. Preserve original ring count, widths, engraved edges and bone-silver linework on black; correct front/back occlusion. No merging, bending, camera motion or extra ornaments.
